skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop skills to use advanced forecasting tools and methods to identify and analyze future trends, aiding in strategic decision-making.
Apply scenario planning techniques to build future scenarios and develop strategic plans for organizations, ensuring flexibility and adaptability.
Analyze and evaluate factors influencing anticipatory governance and develop effective management solutions to respond to business environment changes.
Enhance autonomous planning and change management capabilities, fostering leadership and visionary thinking.
Improve the ability to present ideas logically and argue persuasively.
Understand and apply basic concepts of anticipatory governance and forecasting in economic and social contexts.
